item.title: Publish Issue: Submission will re-open in 2026
item.description: Dear Authors, Due to a high volume of manuscript submissions, Jurnal Online Informatika (JOIN) is temporarily closing new submissions. This decision allows our editorial team to focus on processing and reviewing the manuscripts currently in our system. Submissions will reopen in January 2026.We appreciate your understanding and continued interest in publishing with JOIN. Thank you for your support. Warm regards,JOIN Team
